summary: Package ships Linux/amd64 WebRTC remote-shell agent connecting to hardcoded relay
details: The npm package ships a Linux/amd64 Go binary at bin/sxt that acts as a remote-control agent. The binary links pion/webrtc/v4, pion/turn/v5, pion/dtls/v3, pion/datachannel, creack/pty, and os/exec; connects to a hardcoded WebSocket signaling endpoint at wss://relay.sextant.top (with an install URL at https://relay.sextant.top/install); negotiates a WebRTC DataChannel; and pipes remote-sourced bytes into a PTY spawned around /bin/bash or /bin/sh via $SHELL (creack/pty StartWithSize around os/exec). The result is full interactive shell access to the installer's host for whoever operates the signaling relay. Provenance is consistent with an implant rather than a legitimate CLI: package.json points the license URL at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, and the binary embeds the module path 'claude_control' throughout.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
